rules.text: Dont tell other people secrets unless said so
rules.author: Luke

rules.text: Dont go a full day without saying anything
rules.author: Luke

rules.text: Check with each other before following anyone from our school or that we know of.
rules.author: Charlotte

rules.text: Check with each other before approving of anyone follow us on our shared tt account
rules.author: Charlotte

boundaries.text: Don't harm me when I'm already hurt/injured.
boundaries.author: Luke

boundaries.text: Don't get angry if I'm spending time with other friends.
boundaries.author: Luke

boundaries.text: Don't spread things I've told you privately without my permission, unless it's something where getting a trusted adult involved is necessary for safety.
boundaries.author: Luke

boundaries.text: Don't post/send photos, screenshots, recordings, or messages involving me without checking first when it's something private or embarrassing.
boundaries.author: Luke

boundaries.text: Don't encourage me to ignore injuries or other health problems.
boundaries.author: Luke

boundaries.text: Don't encourage me to do something dangerous to prove I'm loyal/a good friend.
boundaries.author: Luke

boundaries.text: Don't use “I thought you were my boyfriend” as pressure.
boundaries.author: Luke

boundaries.text: We can disagree without attacking each other personally.
boundaries.author: Luke

boundaries.text: If one of us is genuinely upset with the other, we talk about it instead of letting it silently build up.
boundaries.author: Luke

boundaries.text: Either of us can ask for space without it meaning the relationship is ending.
boundaries.author: Luke
